properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: Sheet metal thickness. 0 builds the air space as a solid body instead of a hollow shell

properties.name: InsulationThickness
properties.description: Insulation thickness wrapped around the outside of the fitting; 0 disables insulation

properties.name: TrimNeck
properties.description: Length of the straight collar between the fitting and the duct

properties.name: FaceDiameter
properties.description: Diameter of the round face. 0 uses twice the duct size

properties.name: BodyLength
properties.description: Length of the boot from the duct to the face. 0 uses half the duct size

properties.name: LossMode
properties.description: How the loss is given: a coefficient K, or a fixed pressure drop from the maker's data

properties.name: LossCoefficient
properties.description: Pressure-loss coefficient K, referenced to velocity at the neck

properties.name: NeckSize
properties.description: Equivalent neck diameter the loss coefficient refers to. Used for the loss only, not for the shape

properties.name: PressureDrop
properties.description: Pressure drop in Pa at the design flow, used when LossMode is Fixed pressure drop

properties.name: FlangeHeight
properties.description: Height of the transverse flange at each duct connection

properties.name: FlangeThickness
properties.description: Thickness of the transverse flange; 0 draws no flanges

properties.name: ShowFlange1
properties.description: Include the flange at the duct connection

properties.name: FacePattern
properties.description: How the face is drawn: Louvered (concentric rings), Plaque (a plate in front of the core), Perforated (a plate with holes), Swirl (radial slots)

properties.name: FaceBorder
properties.description: Width of the face border round the core (0 = worked out from the face size)

properties.name: FaceThickness
properties.description: Thickness of the face sheet (0 = worked out from the face size)

properties.name: RingCount
properties.description: Louvered: number of rings

properties.name: RingStep
properties.description: Louvered: how much deeper each ring sits than the one outside it (0 = worked out from the face size)

properties.name: PlaqueSize
properties.description: Plaque: plaque size as a fraction of the core

properties.name: PlaqueGap
properties.description: Plaque: gap between the plaque and the face (0 = worked out from the face size)

properties.name: HoleDiameter
properties.description: Perforated: hole diameter (0 = worked out from the face size)

properties.name: HolePitch
properties.description: Perforated: distance between hole centres (0 = worked out from the face size)

properties.name: SlotCount
properties.description: Swirl: number of slots

properties.name: SlotWidth
properties.description: Swirl: slot width (0 = worked out from the face size)
